description: Log activity, fleet triage, pfSense firewall traffic, and security signals from the Graylog OpenSearch indexes. The Fleet host filter scopes fleet panels. Firewall, CrowdSec, Relay, and all-input panels show their own sources.

panels.title: Indexed messages
panels.description: All records in the Graylog message indexes over the selected time range.

panels.title: Fleet messages
panels.description: TCP syslog from fleet hosts in the current host selection.

panels.title: pfSense firewall blocks
panels.description: Blocked packet log records emitted by the pfSense firewall.

targets.query: gl2_source_input:"${syslog_udp_input:raw}" AND gl2_remote_ip:"${pfsense_ip:raw}" AND source:filterlog* AND facility:local0 AND message:block

panels.title: Fleet warnings and errors
panels.description: Fleet syslog with a severity of warning or higher (0–4).

panels.title: Fleet SSH failures
panels.description: Failed authentication markers from SSH daemon logs on the selected fleet hosts.

targets.query: gl2_source_input:"${syslog_tcp_input:raw}" AND source:(${fleet_host:lucene}) AND application_name:("sshd" OR "sshd-session" OR "sshd-auth") AND message:("Failed password" OR "Invalid user" OR "authentication failure" OR "Failed publickey" OR "maximum authentication attempts")

panels.title: CrowdSec detection records
panels.description: Parsed local detection records in the selected time range. For deduplicated counts and seven days of history, open the CrowdSec search.

panels.title: Indexed volume by input
panels.description: Messages per time bucket. pfSense UDP is filtered by the sender address, and GELF is shown as its own series.

panels.title: Fleet volume by host
panels.description: Counts per host and time bucket, scoped by the fleet host selector.

panels.title: Top fleet hosts
panels.description: Counts by hostname over the selected time range.

panels.title: Fleet warnings and errors over time
panels.description: Warning and error counts from the selected fleet hosts.

panels.title: Top processes with warnings and errors
panels.description: Messages at syslog levels 0–4 from the selected fleet hosts.

panels.title: pfSense firewall passes and blocks
panels.description: Counts logged pass and block records from filterlog. These counts are not total network traffic.

targets.query: gl2_source_input:"${syslog_udp_input:raw}" AND gl2_remote_ip:"${pfsense_ip:raw}" AND source:filterlog* AND facility:local0 AND message:pass
